<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Vampire Servitor](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3224)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Vampires use their servitor pawns for infiltration and reconnaissance.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Undead](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 19

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Vampire_Servitor.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 4">[Vampire Servitor](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3224)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Undead" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=722" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
<trait label="Vampire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=778" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 336

**Perception** +12; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1); plus one regional language

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +11, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +9, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +8, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +5, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +12

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +3

**Dex** +5

**Con** +1

**Int** -1

**Wis** +3

**Cha** +2
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 22 

**Fort** +9 

**Ref** +13 

**Will** +11 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 40
(coffin restoration, [fast healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=62) 5, [void healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=83))

</row>

**Immunities**
[death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=578), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696)

**Resistances**
physical 5 (except [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920))

**Vampire Vulnerabilities** 

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet, climb 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +14 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 1d8+6 slashing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**Drink Blood** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48)) When Drinking Blood, the servitor regains 5 HP.

**[Sneak Attack](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=34)**   The servitor deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) creatures.

</column>
